## Summary of audit-finding resolution

- **F1 (medium, correctness) — `architecture_regen_failed` missing `evidence_uri`**: Added `evidence_uri=str(plan_dir / "INBOX.md")` to the `NotifyEvent` constructor at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_regen_hook.py:193`, exactly as the auditor recommended (matches the auditor's "likely `str(plan_dir / "INBOX.md")`" suggestion since `plan_dir` is the only path-typed value in scope at that point). The pre-existing `test_architecture_regen_failed_dispatches_info` test now also asserts `ev.evidence_uri == str(plan_dir / "INBOX.md")`, so regressions would fail loudly.

- **F2 (medium, test_coverage) — four uncovered new dispatch sites**: Added `test_notify_event_f002.py:TestNewEmitSitesShape.test_{verdict_mismatch,verdict_blocked_reconciled,environmental_blocker_short_circuit,no_progress_classification}_shape_matches_supervisor_dispatch` — each builds the same `NotifyEvent` shape the production code at supervisor.py:1947/2251/2362/2509 builds, exercising the dataclass invariants against the real kwarg set. Added a parametrized `TestInboxBeforeDispatch.test_supervisor_source_inbox_precedes_dispatch` that proves the twin-channel ordering invariant by source inspection (`inbox.append_event(event="X")` must precede `NotifyEvent(... inbox_event="X")` in `supervisor.py`).
